project.title: Accessory Metal Building
project.subtitle: Site plan for a new 20' × 30' detached metal garage with a 12' lean-to
project.use: Example County · Zoning: residential · 0.34 acre corner lot at Example Street and Sample Avenue · Owner of record: Example Owner.

geometry.source: Lot, existing features and elevations from the owner's topographic survey. Building size from the owner's building sketch (20x30x12). Placement, driveway and swale as directed by the engineer and the owner. Example data: the lot is a placeholder, not a real parcel.

summary.headline: A new 29 × 32 garage, 6 ft off the east line and 5 ft off the south line.
summary.text: New detached metal garage (nominal 20 × 30 with a 12 ft lean-to). The lean-to and door openings face Example Street, reached by a 24 ft gravel driveway. Floor at elevation 26.5. A swale along the east side holds 1 in of rain off the new roof and drains north. The house and fences stay; the shed is relocated by the owner.
summary.howToRead: Start with the picture, then the site plan. The enlarged plan gives the stake-out dimensions and the proposed grades. Grey is what the survey found and blue is new work. This set is the site plan: the metal building and its foundation are engineered on separate plans, by others. Example set: names, address and lot are placeholders.
summary.sequenceNote: The sequence is for orientation only. Means, methods and site safety are the contractor's responsibility. The metal building structure and its foundation are engineered on separate plans, by others, and are not part of this sheet.

steps.title: Find the lot lines
steps.text: Locate the found corners shown on the survey (iron pipe at the north-west, capped rod at the north-east, iron rod at the south-west) and string the south and east lines. Do not measure from the fences: the east fence is inside the line and the south fence is outside it.

steps.title: Stake the building
steps.text: Set the east wall 6.0 ft west of the east line and the south wall 5.0 ft north of the south line. 32 ft east-west by 29 ft north-south: 20 ft enclosed on the east, then the 12 ft lean-to toward Example Street. Walk-in door on the north end.
steps.hold: Locate the septic tank and drainfield before any work. Keep the relocated shed at least 5.0 ft clear of the new building.

steps.title: Set the floor
steps.text: Finished floor at elevation 26.5 (NAVD 88), about 1 ft above the ground there now. With the slab thickness, that is about 7 to 12 in of regrading or fill under the slab. Finished grade at the walls about 6 in below the floor, sloping away. On the east side the grade falls from the wall into the swale. Slab, perimeter footing and anchors are by others, on the building plans.

steps.title: Shape the east swale
steps.text: 5 ft wide swale (7½ in deep) between the east wall and the fence, 131 ft long, from the south wall line to the north line, falling north toward Sample Avenue. Its east edge matches existing grade at the fence. North of the building it has 4:1 sides and matches existing grade at both edges. Do not send water onto the neighbour's lot.

steps.title: Build the gravel driveway
steps.text: 24 ft wide from the lean-to straight west to Example Street, about 72 ft, centred on the two openings. Slope it gently from the slab down toward the street, with about a 1% cross slope down to the north so no water runs toward the south lot line. Match existing grade at the west line.
steps.hold: Locate underground utilities before digging. An overhead wire runs along Example Street: verify clearance.

scope.text: 29 ft × 32 ft overall (nominal 20 × 30 × 12): 20 ft enclosed garage plus a 12 ft open lean-to on the west, two 10 × 10 roll-up doors behind two framed openings facing Example Street, walk-in door on the north end. Located by setbacks on sheet C1.0.
5 ft wide, 131 ft long, along the east side from the building's south wall line, draining north. Holds 1 in of rain over the footprint: 204.7 cu ft provided, 77.3 required.
24 ft wide from the lean-to west to Example Street, with a 1% cross slope to the north.
Existing 1-story residence (floor elev. 27.1), fences and utility pole stay as surveyed. The contractor is to confirm access and protect existing utilities.
The existing 7 × 7 shed is movable and is relocated by the owner. Keep it at least 5.0 ft clear of the new building.
Provided on separate plans under the building permit, by the building manufacturer and its engineer. Referenced here, not modified or certified.
By the surveyor. This plan is drawn from the survey and is not a survey.

notes.title: Basis of this plan
items: The survey used is the topographic survey provided by the owner, prepared by a licensed surveyor. Boundary information is as stated on that survey.
Elevations refer to the North American Vertical Datum of 1988 (NAVD 88), as stated on the survey.
Legal description: see the survey.

**Site plan note.** This sheet is not a legal survey. Proposed structures are positioned as shown based on survey provided by others. Aerial layout may differ in field based on topography, soil conditions, existing trees or any number of unforeseen conditions. In the event that the home orientation is altered, notify the engineer to review prior to any construction commencing. Contractor to field verify all dimensions.

**Separate plans.** Foundation and metal structure engineering are on separate plans under the building permit, by the building manufacturer and its engineer. Slab and footing shown here are schematic.

notes.title: Site
items: **Flood zone.** Zone X, as stated on the survey. No flood zone boundary crosses the lot on the survey.
**Easements.** None are shown on the survey.
**Wetlands and waterfront.** None are shown on the survey provided.

**Setbacks.** The building is placed at the minimum setbacks, as selected by the owner: 6.0 ft to the east line and 5.0 ft to the south line. It is 72.0 ft ± from the west line (Example Street) and 102.0 ft ± from the north line (Sample Avenue).

**Utilities.** No underground utilities were located by the survey. An overhead wire runs along Example Street across the driveway, and a utility pole stands north-east of the residence: the contractor is to confirm access and protect existing utilities. [HOLD]

**Septic.** A prior survey shows a septic tank near the south-east side of the residence. Locate the tank and drainfield before construction and keep the building, driveway and regrading clear of them. [HOLD]

**Trees.** The canopy line in the south-east corner is from the survey and reaches over the new building. The two trees located by the survey (12 in and 6 in) stand outside the lot. See general note 15.
**Lot coverage and height.** Maximum 50% and 35 ft. Coverage shown is about 12.9% ±: residence 840, porch 108, shed 49 and new building 928 sq ft on a 14,960 sq ft lot.

notes.title: New building
items: **Location.** South-east corner of the lot. East wall 6.0 ft from the east property line, south wall 5.0 ft from the south property line. The lean-to and the two openings face west to Example Street.

**Separation.** 36.0 ft ± from the north-west corner of the building to the nearest corner of the residence porch. The existing 7 × 7 shed is relocated by the owner and is to stay at least 5.0 ft clear of the new building.

**Finished floor and grades.** Floor at elevation 26.5 NAVD 88. Surveyed ground at the building is about 25.2 to 25.6, so the floor is about 1 ft above it; allowing for the slab thickness, about 7 to 12 in of regrading or fill is needed under the slab. Finished grade at the walls 26.0 ±, about 6 in below the floor, sloped away from the building. On the east side the grade falls from the wall into the swale, see section 2 on sheet C1.0. The edge of Example Street at the driveway is about 26.2.

**Drainage.** Existing ground falls toward the north-east and Sample Avenue, and the new grades keep that direction. The east swale runs from the south wall line of the building to the north line, between the east wall and the fence, and falls about 2% to the north. It is 5 ft wide and 7½ in deep; its east edge matches existing grade at the fence, and north of the building it has 4:1 side slopes and matches existing grade at both edges. Its volume, 1.56 cu ft per foot × 131.0 ft = 204.7 cu ft, exceeds 1 in of rainfall over the 928 sq ft footprint, 77.3 cu ft. See the stormwater check on sheet C1.0.
**Lot grading.** Lot grading to maintain its historical flow path preventing the accumulation of water or excessive runoff onto adjacent properties.

**Access.** New gravel driveway, 24 ft wide, from the lean-to straight west to Example Street, about 72 ft long on the lot. It slopes about 0.6% from the slab to the west line and matches existing grade there, with about a 1% cross slope down to the north so that runoff sheds onto the grass on the lot and not toward the south lot line. The existing fence along Example Street stands in the right-of-way: the opening at the driveway and the connection to the pavement are by the contractor, coordinated with the county.

generalNotes.title: Site plan and permitting
items: THESE PLANS ARE FOR SITE PLAN AND PERMITTING PURPOSES ONLY FOR THE PROPOSED ACCESSORY METAL BUILDING AT THE ADDRESS SHOWN IN THE TITLE BLOCK.

PROPERTY BOUNDARIES, DIMENSIONS, EASEMENTS, EXISTING STRUCTURES, AND SITE FEATURES ARE BASED ON THE SURVEY REFERENCED ON THESE PLANS, PREPARED BY OTHERS. NO INDEPENDENT BOUNDARY OR TOPOGRAPHIC SURVEY WAS PERFORMED AS PART OF THESE PLANS.

THE CONTRACTOR SHALL FIELD VERIFY ALL EXISTING CONDITIONS, DIMENSIONS, ELEVATIONS, AND THE PROPOSED BUILDING LOCATION PRIOR TO CONSTRUCTION. ANY DISCREPANCIES SHALL BE REPORTED TO THE DESIGN PROFESSIONAL PRIOR TO PROCEEDING.

THE PROPOSED STRUCTURE SHALL BE LOCATED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE SETBACKS AND DIMENSIONS SHOWN ON THIS SITE PLAN. THE CONTRACTOR SHALL VERIFY COMPLIANCE WITH ALL APPLICABLE ZONING REQUIREMENTS AND PERMIT CONDITIONS PRIOR TO CONSTRUCTION.

NO CONSTRUCTION, FOUNDATION ELEMENTS, OR PERMANENT IMPROVEMENTS SHALL ENCROACH INTO PROPERTY SETBACKS, EASEMENTS, RIGHTS-OF-WAY, OR RESTRICTED AREAS WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL FROM THE APPLICABLE AUTHORITY.

STRUCTURAL DESIGN, SUPERSTRUCTURE PLANS, FOUNDATION DESIGN, ANCHORAGE, AND CONNECTION DETAILS ARE PROVIDED UNDER SEPARATE DOCUMENTS BY OTHERS. THIS SITE PLAN DOES NOT MODIFY OR SUPERSEDE THE APPROVED STRUCTURAL OR FOUNDATION DOCUMENTS.

FINISHED FLOOR ELEVATIONS, WHERE INDICATED, SHALL BE VERIFIED AGAINST APPLICABLE FLOODPLAIN REQUIREMENTS AND FIELD CONDITIONS PRIOR TO CONSTRUCTION. ELEVATION CERTIFICATION, WHEN REQUIRED, SHALL BE PROVIDED BY A QUALIFIED PROFESSIONAL.

EXISTING DRAINAGE PATTERNS SHALL BE MAINTAINED TO THE EXTENT PRACTICABLE. PROPOSED IMPROVEMENTS SHALL NOT CREATE ADVERSE DRAINAGE IMPACTS TO ADJACENT PROPERTIES, RIGHTS-OF-WAY, OR EXISTING DRAINAGE FACILITIES. ANY REQUIRED GRADING OR DRAINAGE DESIGN SHALL BE PROVIDED SEPARATELY.
THE CONTRACTOR SHALL LOCATE AND VERIFY ALL EXISTING ABOVEGROUND AND UNDERGROUND UTILITIES PRIOR TO EXCAVATION OR CONSTRUCTION. CONTACT SUNSHINE 811 PRIOR TO DIGGING AS REQUIRED.
THE CONTRACTOR SHALL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR OBTAINING ALL REQUIRED PERMITS, COORDINATING INSPECTIONS, MAINTAINING JOBSITE SAFETY, AND COMPLYING WITH APPLICABLE OSHA REQUIREMENTS.
ANY DAMAGE TO EXISTING STRUCTURES, UTILITIES, PAVEMENT, LANDSCAPING, OR ADJACENT IMPROVEMENTS RESULTING FROM CONSTRUCTION SHALL BE REPAIRED BY THE CONTRACTOR.

ANY WETLANDS, FLOODPLAIN RESTRICTIONS, CONSERVATION AREAS, OR OTHER ENVIRONMENTALLY SENSITIVE FEATURES AFFECTING THE PROPOSED WORK SHALL BE ADDRESSED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF THE APPLICABLE AUTHORITIES. NO DISTURBANCE OF PROTECTED AREAS IS AUTHORIZED BY THIS SITE PLAN.

THE CONTRACTOR SHALL NOTIFY THE DESIGN PROFESSIONAL OF ANY CONFLICTS, OMISSIONS, OR DISCREPANCIES BETWEEN THE SITE PLAN, SURVEY, APPROVED BUILDING PLANS, AND ACTUAL FIELD CONDITIONS PRIOR TO PROCEEDING WITH THE AFFECTED WORK.
AN APPROVED COPY OF THE SITE PLAN AND APPLICABLE PERMIT DOCUMENTS SHALL BE MAINTAINED AT THE PROJECT SITE DURING CONSTRUCTION.

EXISTING TREES SHALL BE PROTECTED AND PRESERVED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE APPLICABLE COUNTY TREE PRESERVATION REQUIREMENTS. THE COUNTY SHALL BE NOTIFIED PRIOR TO THE REMOVAL OF ANY TREE. NO TREE REMOVAL IS PROPOSED BY THIS SITE PLAN.
